extracted: Of 25 psychiatric trials of classic psychedelics up to December 2023 (substance use disorder trials excluded): 16 played a predefined selection of music through headphones; one alternated music and silence without headphones; two allowed no music (music and films not allowed in one; no music and no decoration in the other); 11 asked participants to wear an eye mask throughout.
